question.text: The Code of Conduct for AIFs is specified in which Schedule of SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 5.16.2 explicitly references the Fourth Schedule of SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations. **The Trap:** First/Second/Third Schedules contain other content (registration, fees, etc.). **Cross-Exam Context:** Same Fourth Schedule applies to Cat I/II (XIX-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Read the Fourth Schedule end-to-end at least annually — it's the baseline for compliance training.
